verdict.rationale: Milvus Lite provides an embedded, file-based local instance instantiated via a single MilvusClient("file.db") call, sharing the same API/client code as Standalone/Distributed and covering most core features (CRUD, search, filtering, hybrid search), explicitly targeted at laptops/Jupyter notebooks for prototyping. Community mentions corroborate real-world lightweight usage. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking or confirmation of Milvus Lite's limitations/edge cases beyond vendor docs.
